const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""RoboLab limited-mode interactive controller for condiments_in_bin.
+
+The command loop keeps a single rcb-limited/2.0 client alive. Send one JSON
+object per line on stdin, for example:
+  {"cmd":"ee", "actions":[[x,y,z,qw,qx,qy,qz,grip], ...]}
+  {"cmd":"obs"}
+  {"cmd":"watch", "seconds":2}
+Execution artifacts are saved below /app/output/stages.
+"""
+import json
+import pathlib
+import sys
+import time
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot, EpisodeOver
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/output")
+STAGES = OUT / "stages"
+STAGES.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+r = Robot()
+(OUT / "spec.json").write_text(json.dumps(r.spec(), indent=2))
+counter = 0
+
+
+def save_result(res, label):
+    d = STAGES / label
+    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    (d / "meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(res.meta, indent=2))
+    for cam, img in res.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(img).save(d / f"{cam}.jpg", quality=92)
+    for cam, frames in res.frames.items():
+        (d / f"frames_{cam}.npy").write_bytes(b"") if False else None
+        for i, frame in enumerate(frames):
+            Image.fromarray(frame).save(d / f"{cam}_{i:03}.jpg", quality=88)
+    for cam, video in res.video.items():
+        (d / f"{cam}.mp4").write_bytes(video)
+
+
+def state(res):
+    p = res.meta.get("proprio", {})
+    return {
+        "time_left_s": res.meta.get("time_left_s"),
+        "sim_time_s": res.meta.get("sim_time_s"),
+        "done": res.meta.get("done"),
+        "reason": res.meta.get("reason"),
+        "proprio": p.get("now"),
+    }
+
+
+print(json.dumps({"ready": True, "spec": r.spec(), "proprio": r.get_obs(video="none").meta.get("proprio")}, separators=(",", ":")), flush=True)
+
+for line in sys.stdin:
+    line = line.strip()
+    if not line:
+        continue
+    try:
+        cmd = json.loads(line)
+        kind = cmd.get("cmd")
+        counter += 1
+        label = cmd.get("label", f"call_{counter:03d}")
+        if kind == "ee":
+            result = r.submit(
+                "ee_pose", np.asarray(cmd["actions"], dtype=np.float32),
+                video=cmd.get("video", "frames"),
+                video_fps=int(cmd.get("video_fps", 5)),
+                note=cmd.get("note", label),
+            )
+        elif kind == "joint":
+            result = r.submit(
+                "joint_position", np.asarray(cmd["actions"], dtype=np.float32),
+                dt=float(cmd.get("dt", 1 / 15)),
+                video=cmd.get("video", "frames"),
+                video_fps=int(cmd.get("video_fps", 5)),
+                note=cmd.get("note", label),
+            )
+        elif kind in ("obs", "watch"):
+            result = r.get_obs(
+                seconds=float(cmd.get("seconds", 0 if kind == "obs" else 2)),
+                video=cmd.get("video", "frames"),
+                video_fps=int(cmd.get("video_fps", 5)),
+            )
+        elif kind == "status":
+            print(json.dumps({"status": r.status()}, separators=(",", ":")), flush=True)
+            continue
+        elif kind == "quit":
+            break
+        else:
+            raise ValueError(f"unknown cmd {kind!r}")
+        save_result(result, label)
+        print(json.dumps({"label": label, "meta": result.meta, "state": state(result)}, separators=(",", ":")), flush=True)
+        if result.done:
+            print("EPISODE_DONE", flush=True)
+            break
+    except EpisodeOver as exc:
+        print(json.dumps({"episode_over": str(exc)}), flush=True)
+        break
+    except Exception as exc:
+        print(json.dumps({"error": type(exc).__name__, "detail": str(exc)}), flush=True)
*** End Patch";
const r = await tools.apply_patch(patch);
text(r);
